output.answer: Goldman Sachs' chief technology officer is John Madsen, a 20-plus-year Goldman veteran who was named CTO in August 2024 after the prior CTO, Atte Lahtiranta, left for Citadel. Madsen leads the firm's core engineering teams and reports to chief information officer Marco Argenti, who sets the firm's overall technology strategy. Note that in September 2026 Goldman also hired Dinesh Keswani as chief technology officer of The Core Engineering (a division-level CTO role), but the firmwide CTO remains Madsen.
caveats: Goldman Sachs has not published a firmwide leadership page confirming Madsen's CTO title; the identification rests on Business Insider's reporting of the August 2024 internal memo, his LinkedIn profile (still showing Goldman Sachs as current employer as of 2026-11-11), and continued references to him as 'our CTO' in 2024-2025 Goldman-affiliated posts.

The distinction between the firmwide CTO and the division-level CTO of The Core Engineering (Dinesh Keswani, since September 3, 2026) can cause confusion; Keswani's role is scoped to The Core Engineering, not the whole firm.

passages.quote: Goldman Sachs has named tech veteran John Madsen as its chief technology officer, Business Insider has learned.

Madsen's appointment comes after Goldman lost its current CTO, Atte Lahtiranta, to Ken Griffin's hedge fund, Citadel... Madsen, currently head of core engineering, will transition to CTO as Lahtiranta departs the firm. Madsen will continue to report to Chief Information Officer Marco Argenti.

The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. (NYSE: GS) today announced that Dinesh Keswani has joined the firm as a Partner and co-head of The Core Engineering alongside Gopi Parameswaran. Dinesh will also serve as chief technology officer of The Core Engineering.
Argenti is Goldman Sachs' chief information officer... Before joining Goldman in 2019, he was a top Amazon executive, helping build out its cloud-computing business.

output.question: Who is Goldman Sachs' CTO?

key_facts.fact: John Madsen was named chief technology officer of Goldman Sachs in August 2024, succeeding Atte Lahtiranta, who left to join Citadel.
As CTO, Madsen reports to Chief Information Officer Marco Argenti and continues to oversee core engineering teams.
Madsen joined Goldman Sachs in 2003, became a partner in 2014, previously served as CTO from 2017 to 2020, and became head of the firm's core engineering unit in March 2024.
Madsen's LinkedIn profile still lists Goldman Sachs as his current employer as of November 11, 2026, consistent with him remaining at the firm.

On September 3, 2026, Goldman Sachs hired Dinesh Keswani as a partner and co-head of The Core Engineering alongside Gopi Parameswaran, and as chief technology officer of The Core Engineering — a division-level CTO role, not the firmwide CTO position.
